meta.name: The Blue Road
meta.description: Two detectives join forces when brutal murders and cryptic messages surface across borders — but the deadly truth lurks dangerously close.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: During the 2002 World Cup, a macabre Tokyo murder pits Hiroshi Inose against suspicious Korean detective Kim Seok — until they reluctantly team up.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Back in Seoul after deceiving Japanese police, Kim Seok gets a surprise offer from Inose — just as the killer's crime-scene message surfaces online.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A crucial testimony leads Kim Seok and Inose to identify the killer as Emi Shunsuke. But a call from the precinct sends the case in a new direction.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Emi continues to outsmart the detectives, a disturbing note found in his house rattles Kim Seok and drives the pair to Emi's performance venue.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Despite official police intervention, Kim Seok and Inose investigate from their home countries. Later, Kim Seok confronts pachinko kingpin Seo Hyun-tae.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Framed and on the run, Kim Seok reaches Hong Kong. Inose meets agent Yoon Soo-kyung and learns Hyun-tae's dark scheme is already in motion.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Kim Seok captures and tortures Hyun-tae to unearth buried memories, only to be left spiraling until unexpected help arrives.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Kim Seok reaches Central Asia's Blue Road in pursuit of Hyun-tae, but a calm confession reveals the brutal truth may be closer than he thinks.
